annotations.exact_quote: this article proposes a novel jointly optimized and trainable framework named graph masked autoencoders with relationship-aware learning (GMARC) for HSI clustering
annotations.reason_zh: 提出可联合优化的可训练框架用于HSI聚类，利用图掩码自编码器学习表示并服务聚类划分，符合深度聚类。

annotations.exact_quote: Hyperspectral image (HSI) clustering is a fundamental yet challenging task.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文直接研究高光谱图像（HSI）数据上的聚类任务。

annotations.exact_quote: which is the first to apply masked graph autoencoders (MGAEs) to HSI clustering tasks
annotations.reason_zh: 核心方法为图掩码自编码器，属于在图上进行可学习神经表示提取的图神经网络方法。

annotations.exact_quote: we propose a relationship-aware learning module (RAL), explicitly constructing both global and local relationships to enrich data representations
annotations.reason_zh: RAL显式构造全局与局部节点关系，学习样本间关系/亲和结构，符合图结构学习。

annotations.exact_quote: reinforcing the feature consistency among positive pairs and reducing correlation among negative pairs
annotations.reason_zh: 通过增强正节点对特征一致性并降低负节点对相关性来学习表示，符合对比学习的吸引与区分目标。

abstentions.reason_zh: 虽有局部关系与正节点对一致性线索，但未明确使用邻域图拉普拉斯或流形一致性约束，机制无法确定。
